description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - The Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has decided to cancel the licence issued to Central Investments and Finance PLC., with effect from 5th March 2018
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license for a specific company (Central Investments and Finance PLC) under the Finance Business Act. This falls under commercial regulatory matters involving business licensing and financial institution regulations, which aligns with Type 6 (Commercial Gazettes) for business and commercial matters.
